title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Agreement Terms: Signing, Contracted Rate and Onboarding Fee
content:
## 1. What may be signed

1.1 An agreement is signed for one ClearPath Managed IT Services tier, at a seat commitment no lower than that tier's minimum seats and for a term listed among the tier's allowed terms. A request for a seat commitment or term the tier does not offer cannot be signed on that tier.

1.2 ClearPath Premier and ClearPath Enterprise may be signed only while the client holds a Sentinel Managed Security subscription whose status is active. The condition is read before signing from the company's system record of the same client's Sentinel Managed Security subscription; the status on that record decides it.

## 2. Contracted rate

The contracted per-seat rate is the tier's list monthly fee per seat reduced by the tier's term discount for the signed term length, rounded half up to the cent.

## 3. Onboarding fee

3.1 The onboarding fee equals the tier's onboarding fee per seat multiplied by the contracted seats, but never less than the tier's minimum onboarding fee. It is invoiced on the signing date with payment due under the tier's payment terms (its net days after posting).

3.2 The onboarding fee is waived entirely when the initial term is at least the tier's waiver term, in which case no onboarding fee is posted at all.

3.3 Renewal terms and tier changes never generate an onboarding fee.

## 4. Worked illustration (hypothetical inputs)

Take a hypothetical tier with a list fee of 100.00 per seat, a 24-month discount of 2 percent, an onboarding fee of 50.00 per seat, a minimum onboarding fee of 1500.00 and a waiver term of 36 months.

| Signed | Contracted rate | Onboarding fee |
|---|---|---|
| 40 seats, 24 months | 100.00 less 2 percent, that is 98.00 | 40 times 50.00, that is 2000.00, above the minimum: 2000.00 |
| 20 seats, 24 months | 98.00 | 20 times 50.00 is 1000.00, below the minimum: 1500.00 |
| 20 seats, 36 months | at the 36-month discount | waived; no onboarding fee posted |
| 20 seats, 18 months | not signable: 18 months is not an allowed term | none |
